name: nuScenes
world_model_relevance: Common source for driving world models, trajectory prediction, occupancy, and scenario generation.
caveats: Requires account and terms; logs are not equivalent to counterfactual closed-loop simulation.

name: Waymo Open Dataset
world_model_relevance: Important for multi-sensor driving prediction, evaluation, and scenario analysis.
caveats: Terms restrict use; dataset page warns it is for research and not real-life vehicle performance evaluation.

name: BEHAVIOR-1K
world_model_relevance: Tests long-horizon household tasks and physical-social interactions relevant to embodied world models.
caveats: Task success in simulation does not automatically prove real-world transfer.

name: EgoSchema
world_model_relevance: Useful probe for long temporal memory and human activity understanding.
caveats: QA benchmark, not an intervention simulator.

name: OpenEQA
world_model_relevance: Evaluates grounded environment understanding from memory and exploration.
caveats: Does not directly measure whether a model can roll out action-conditioned futures.

name: IRASim Benchmark
caveats: Contact and control validity require task-level robot checks, not only video metrics.

name: Atari 100k
world_model_relevance: Common benchmark for sample-efficient model-based RL and DIAMOND-style world-model agents.
caveats: Game domain; results should not be overgeneralized to real-world physics.

name: DeepMind Control Suite
world_model_relevance: Common control suite for latent dynamics and model-based RL systems such as Dreamer and TD-MPC2.
caveats: Simulated physics and relatively narrow tasks; not enough for deployment claims.
